info.title: Auth Service
info.description: Authentication, authorization, API keys, roles, and user management for OnePlatform. Provides JWT-based session management, OAuth 2.0 provider flows, and RBAC.

tags.name: Bootstrap
tags.description: First-run platform initialization. One-time use — returns 410 Gone after completion.

tags.name: Auth
tags.description: Login, logout, token refresh, and password reset flows

tags.name: OAuth
tags.description: OAuth 2.0 provider authorization and callback flows

tags.name: API Keys
tags.description: Programmatic access credentials scoped to specific permissions

tags.name: Roles
tags.description: RBAC role management for tenant-scoped access control
